scope: The 1953 Australian Inland Mission Hospital on its protected Birdsville parcel, with enclosed corrugated verandahs, the separate former Aboriginal ward, its service buildings, entrance walk and tanks.

review.notes: Qualla imagery was assessed first. The 1953 photograph has a domestic Australian expiry tag, and its archive record does not establish a public-domain basis for this use. The present-day exterior photograph uses CC BY-SA. The surveyed site description and mapped footprint guide the reconstruction.
